Class ValuationPoints

java.lang.Object
grafioschtrader.reportviews.performance.ValuationPoints
public final class ValuationPoints extends Object
Turns daily holdings into the valuation points of a time-weighted series. Shared by the period performance report and the dashboard, so both value a day and split its flows the same way and therefore agree on every day both show.

  • Method Details

    • of

      public static List<ReturnSeries.ValuationPoint> of(List<? extends IPeriodHolding> holdings, List<IDailyExternalFlow> dailyFlows, BiPredicate<LocalDate, LocalDate> regular)
      Builds the points. The value includes the open result of margin positions. The net flow of an interval comes from the cumulative external cash transfer of the holdings; the dated flows only tell how much of it was withdrawn, so that the withdrawals count as flowed at the end and the rest as flowed at the start of the interval.
      Parameters:
      holdings - daily holdings in ascending order of the day, the first one is the excluded base
      dailyFlows - net external flows per calendar day, ascending by date
      regular - decides from the previous and the current day whether an interval misses no expected trading day
      Returns:
      one point per holding
